# StarLayer API Reference

*Companion to [`functionality-overview.md`](functionality-overview.md) — that document says what's supported; this one is an organized index of the actual importable names. Generated by introspecting the real, installed code (not hand-transcribed), so it stays accurate as the API grows — regenerate rather than hand-edit if it drifts.*

**Columns**: **Kind** — method / property / attribute / function / class / value. **Status** (classes that extend an underlying library only) — **New** (StarLayer-only, no such name on the base class), **Modified** (StarLayer overrides/extends the base class's own method of the same name), **Unchanged** (inherited as-is, listed for completeness since you asked for the full surface, not just StarLayer's own additions).

**Package hierarchy**: `starlayer` is the actual top-level package (`pip install starlayer`) — a small, deliberately curated re-export over the three packages underneath it. `starlayergraph`/`starsparql`/`starshacl` are those three underlying packages (plus `starontology`, a dependency-free data-only package all three of them draw on); `starlayergraph` is *not* the top layer despite hosting the cross-package ontology/SHACL registry (see its own note below for why it lives there).

---

## `starlayer`

The full curated top-level surface (`from starlayer import ...`) — every name here is the *exact same object* as its source package's own export, nothing redefined or copied. Deliberately not a flattened union of all three packages' own `__all__`: `starsparql.validate()` and `starshacl.validate()` would silently shadow one another with different meanings (SPARQL-algebra-graph validation vs. SHACL validation), so neither is re-exported here — import those two from their owning package directly.

| Name | Kind | Source package | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `StarLayerGraph` | class | `starlayergraph` | See the `starlayergraph` section below |
| `StarLayerDataset` | class | `starlayergraph` | See the `starlayergraph` section below |
| `TripleTerm` | class | `starlayergraph` | See the `starlayergraph` section below |
| `DirLangString` | class | `starlayergraph` | See the `starlayergraph` section below |
| `StarShaclValidator` | class | `starshacl` | See the `starshacl` section below |
| `Graph` | class | `starlayergraph` (rdflib re-export) | Plain `rdflib.Graph` |
| `Dataset` | class | `starlayergraph` (rdflib re-export) | Plain `rdflib.Dataset` |
| `BNode` / `Literal` / `URIRef` / `Variable` | class | `starlayergraph` (rdflib re-export) | rdflib's own term types |
| `Namespace` | class | `starlayergraph` (rdflib re-export) | rdflib's "generate URIRefs with a common prefix" helper |
| `RDF` / `RDFS` / `XSD` | value | `starlayergraph` (rdflib re-export) | rdflib's own bound namespaces |

*Not re-exported here — import from the owning package directly*: `starsparql.prepare_query_12`/`query_to_rdf`/... , the whole SRL family, `starshacl.validate`/`apply_rules`/`close_shape`/..., anything under `starontology`, and both packages' own `validate()` functions (the collision noted above).

### Ontology / SHACL registry (`starlayergraph.ontology`)

| Name | Description |

| `ontology_graph()` | The `manch:` RDFS ontology |
| `skos_ontology_graph()` | The `skos:` OWL/RDFS ontology |
| `manchester_shapes.shapes_graph()` / `.validate(data_graph)` | `manch:` SHACL shapes + validator |
| `skos_shapes.shapes_graph()` / `.validate(data_graph)` | `skos:` SHACL shapes + validator |

Registered entry names (via `list_ontologies()`): `manchester_owl`, `manchester_shacl`, `skos_owl`, `skos_shacl`, `sparql_owl`, `sparql_shacl`, `srl_owl`, `srl_shacl`, `shacl_meta`.

### `srl_ast` — the AST dataclasses (no methods; fields only)

| Name | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `RuleSet` | `rules`, `data`, `imports` | §4.1 "Rule set" |
| `Rule` | `head`, `body`, `data`, `id` | §4.1 "Rule" |
| `Data` | `triples` | §4.1 "Data block" — ground triples only |
| `TriplePattern` (aka `TripleTemplate`) | `subject`, `predicate`, `object` | Same shape used for both rule heads and bodies |
| `FilterElement` | `expr` | `FILTER(...)` — `expr` is a real rdflib `Expr` tree |
| `AssignmentElement` | `var`, `expr` | `SET (?var := expr)` |
| `NegationElement` | `inner`, `data` | `NOT DATA? { ... }` |

| `normalize_to_starlayer_graph` | function | Normalize an input graph to a `StarLayerGraph` |
| `normalize_graph_inputs` | function | Normalize the various graph-input shapes callers may pass |
| `ExecutionDiagnostics` | class | Counters for one validation run (encode/decode calls, triple-term counts, ...) |
| `ValidationResult` | class | `conforms`, `report_graph`, `report_text`, `data_graph`, `diagnostics` |
| `RulesResult` | class | Result of `apply_rules()` — `data_graph`, `report_graph`, `report_text`, `conforms`, `diagnostics` |
| `EvaluationResult` | class | Result of `evaluate()` — SHACL 1.2 Node Expressions |
| `SubgraphExtractionResult` | class | Result of `extract_subgraph()` |
| `ValidationProfile` | class | `(name, options)` — a SHACL 1.2 Profiling profile |
| `available_profiles` | function | List the built-in validation profiles |
| `get_profile` | function | Look up one profile by name |
| `resolve_profile_options` | function | Resolve a profile's options against caller overrides |
| `declared_conformance_profile` | function | A fresh copy of starshacl's bundled self-declared SHACL 1.2 conformance |
| `derive_conforms_to` | function | Derive `sh:conformsTo` triples from a validation report |
| `StarLayerGraphProtocol` | class | Structural protocol every graph-like input must satisfy |
| `MutableStarLayerGraphProtocol` | class | `StarLayerGraphProtocol` + mutation methods |

### `StarShaclValidator` — own methods (no base class — wraps pyshacl by composition, not inheritance)

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `validate` | method | SHACL validation |
| `apply_rules` | method | SHACL-AF rule execution (`sh:rule`/`sh:TripleRule`/`sh:SPARQLRule`) |
| `evaluate` | method | SHACL 1.2 Node Expressions — a third, independent processing mode |
| `extract_subgraph` | method | SHACL-driven subgraph extraction — a fourth, independent processing mode |
| `evaluate_component` | method | Lower-level: evaluate one native `ConstraintComponent` directly |
| `build_report` | method | Lower-level: build a `sh:ValidationReport` graph directly |
| `target_nodes` | method | Lower-level: resolve a shape's target nodes directly |

### Underlying `pyshacl` surface `StarShaclValidator` wraps

*No inheritance relationship exists (`StarShaclValidator` is `object`-derived), so there's no "modified pyshacl method" table the way there is for rdflib — this project calls these as a library, by composition.*

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `pyshacl.validate(...)` | The plain-pySHACL function `StarShaclValidator.validate()` wraps, adding RDF 1.2/triple-term adaptation around it |
| `pyshacl.rules.shacl_rule.SHACLRule` | The rule-execution machinery `apply_rules()` drives |
| `pyshacl.constraints.constraint_component.ConstraintComponent` | The base class starshacl's own native constraint components (e.g. `srl`/`salg`-specific ones) subclass |

---

## `starontology`

Pure data — no logic, no `pyshacl` dependency. One ontology + one shapes file per vocabulary.

| Name | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `manchester_ontology_graph()` | function | The `manch:` RDFS ontology |
| `manchester_shapes_graph()` | function | The `manch:` SHACL shapes |
| `skos_ontology_graph()` | function | The `skos:` OWL/RDFS ontology |
| `skos_shapes_graph()` | function | The `skos:` SHACL shapes |
| `sparql_ontology_graph()` | function | The `salg:` RDFS ontology |
| `sparql_shapes_graph()` | function | The `salg:` SHACL shapes |
| `srl_ontology_graph()` | function | The `srl:` RDFS ontology |
| `srl_shapes_graph()` | function | The `srl:` SHACL shapes |

| `MANCHESTER_SHAPES_TTL_PATH` | value | Path to `manchester_shapes.ttl` |
| `SKOS_ONTOLOGY_TTL_PATH` | value | Path to `skos-ontology.ttl` |
| `SKOS_SHAPES_TTL_PATH` | value | Path to `skos_shapes.ttl` |
| `SPARQL_ONTOLOGY_TTL_PATH` | value | Path to `salg-ontology.ttl` |
| `SPARQL_SHAPES_TTL_PATH` | value | Path to `sparql_shapes.ttl` |
| `SRL_ONTOLOGY_TTL_PATH` | value | Path to `srl-ontology.ttl` |
| `SRL_SHAPES_TTL_PATH` | value | Path to `srl_shapes.ttl` |
